description: Canonical reducer vectors for the acp-go.dev/lifecycle extension. Every fixture is a wire-level expectation: any implementation that reduces the extension envelope must reach the stated verdict from these bytes, whether it is an agent validating its own emitted stream or a host consuming one.

inputShape.notification: An element carrying `method` and `params` is one delivered notification. JSON-RPC framing is omitted; `params` is the notification payload verbatim, with the extension envelope at `params._meta["acp-go.dev/lifecycle"]`.
inputShape.control: An element carrying only `control` is an out-of-band wire event with no notification of its own. The vocabulary is closed at `session_closed`, meaning `session/close` completed for the addressed session.
inputShape.comparison: Notifications are compared as decoded values, never as encoded bytes: key order and insignificant whitespace are never differences. That is the same rule the deep-equality retransmission test uses.
inputShape.waiver: The `updatesOutsidePrompt` in-flight leg of `unnegotiated_fact` — an envelope delivered while no prompt is in flight on a configuration answering `false` — is not expressible here: this shape carries no prompt-boundary marker. It is discharged at the session layer that owns prompt boundaries, and no vector claims it.

expectShape.verdict: `accepted` when every input reduces, `fail_closed` when one is refused.
expectShape.violation: Present on `fail_closed` only: one token from the closed violation vocabulary.
expectShape.atInput: Present on `fail_closed` only: the zero-based index into the `input` array — counting `control` elements — of the element that must be refused.
expectShape.postRefusal: Present on `fail_closed` only, and optional: further inputs in the same shape as `input`, delivered after the refusal. Fail closed latches, so a harness MUST feed every one of them and MUST assert that each is refused with the same token at the same `(streamId, sequence)` identity and that `state` still holds afterwards. A harness that stops feeding at the first refusal cannot tell a consumer that stopped reducing from one that kept going past a verdict it had already returned.
expectShape.state: The projection at the moment of refusal, taken before any fail-closed handling the consumer performs; on an `accepted` fixture, the projection after the last input. Terminalizing held entities and refusing to certify further boundaries happen after this projection is taken and are not pinned here.

stateShape.comparison: Exact equality. Every member listed above is present in every fixture; an extra or missing member fails the fixture.
stateShape.streamId: The current incarnation's stream. A projection is per incarnation and never adopts a prior incarnation's turns, activities, actions, or watermark.
stateShape.reducedThrough: The highest reduced sequence on that stream, or 0 when nothing reduced.
stateShape.suppressedRetransmissions: The count of wholesale-suppressed exact retransmissions. Always present, 0 when none occurred.
stateShape.foreground: `null` before the snapshot reduces. Otherwise `state` and `cycleId` always, plus `turnId` exactly while a turn is open.
stateShape.turns: Each entry carries `turnId`, `origin` (`submission` or `activity` — the two events that open a turn), and `terminal`, plus `outcome` exactly on a terminal turn, which an ending `idle` is required to carry.
stateShape.activities: Each entry carries `activityId`, `kind`, `state`, and `originTurnId`, plus `parentId`, `toolCallId`, and `runId` exactly when the activity's first sight supplied them. `cause` and `progress` are reduced but not projected. Terminal activities stay in the projection.
stateShape.actions: Each entry carries `actionId`, `kind`, `state`, `owner`, and `blocksForeground`, plus `runId` exactly when the first sight supplied it. Terminal actions stay in the projection.
stateShape.quiescence: `certified` always, plus `source`, `watermark`, and `barrier` exactly when the certifying event carried them, plus `invalidatedAt` — the sequence of the first event that began or recorded live work since the last certification — exactly when a previously certified fact was invalidated and not yet recertified. The invalidating set is the contract's: an acceptance, a transition to `running` or `requires_action`, or an activity or action record that is nonterminal.

fixtures.invariant: A stream's first event is lifecycle_snapshot; any delta before it is refused.
Acceptance is distinct from running, and it invalidates the prior quiescence fact.
running to activity-running to idle settles the turn and certifies no boundary while the activity is live.
An idle-to-running transition with no submission opens an agent-origin turn, and only the final quiescence_update certifies the boundary.
A quiescence fact invalidated by later acceptance cannot certify a later activity-free boundary.
A repeated sequence identity carrying different content is refused.
A deeply equal retransmission of the whole notification is suppressed wholesale and changes nothing.
A skipped sequence is refused; contiguity is the loss detector.
A sequence below a resumed stream's snapshot boundary is refused rather than reduced as history.
A terminal activity never changes state again.
A parent activity cannot terminalize while an owned descendant is nonterminal.
A terminal activity never gains a child; a new activity naming a terminal parent is refused.
A later activity_update restating an immutable identity field with a different value is refused as an identity change, not as an unknown member.
A first-sight activity whose origin turn was first seen at or before a certified watermark is refused; the settled boundary never reopens.
An event naming an entity the stream never introduced — a parentId with no prior first sight, an origin turn or owner the stream never opened — is refused rather than reduced as unattached state.
An action that does not block the foreground cycle leaves foreground state unchanged.
A background action stays pending across its turn's terminal idle, keeping its owning activity nonterminal.
A blocking action projects requires_action only through its own accompanying state_update, and the cycle returns to running when the last blocker resolves.
A requires_action transition with no outstanding blocking action is refused.
The identity-only session_info_update is the only legal carrier; an envelope on any other sessionUpdate variant is refused.
An envelope whose version is outside the negotiated set is refused.
An event carrying a member this contract does not fix is refused rather than reduced with the member ignored.
A wrong-typed envelope member is refused as malformed; structural validity is checked before ordering.
An event.type outside the closed six is refused.
An event asserting a fact the negotiated answer did not claim is refused.
A second lifecycle_snapshot on a live stream is refused; the same shape on a fenced streamId is stale_stream instead.
A configuration answering updatesOutsidePrompt false opens one incarnation per prompt, each a distinct streamId with its own snapshot, sequence space, and entities.
A completed close fences the stream; a later event on that streamId is refused.
A resumed stream's snapshot introduces the turn its foreground reports, the turns its activities name as origin, and its own nonterminal sets; later patches resolve against them.
A snapshot reporting running names the open turn and that turn's origin, and the consumer projects it as an open turn.
A snapshot may resume a cycle a blocking action stopped, and that cycle returns to running only once the blocker terminalizes.
A snapshot's references resolve inside the snapshot; a parent absent from its own sets is refused, and a refused snapshot opens nothing.
A snapshot states the complete nonterminal sets, so an entry that is already terminal is refused as malformed.
A foreground turn is present only while a turn is open, so an idle snapshot carrying one is refused.
A snapshot whose own sets contradict the positive quiescence fact it carries is refused rather than certifying nothing.
A first-sight activity naming an origin turn the stream never opened is refused.
An action naming an owner the stream never introduced is refused rather than reduced as an ownerless request.
A session-caused transition never opens a turn, so one naming a turn the stream never introduced is refused.
A second acceptance of a turn the stream already introduced is an identity change, not a second turn.
An idle transition that ends an open turn without an outcome is refused as malformed.
An ending idle whose outcome is failed carries no stop reason: no ACP v1 stop reason names a failure, so the omission is the required shape.
An ending idle whose outcome is failed and which carries a stop reason is refused as malformed.
A first-sight activity whose parent was first seen at or before a certified watermark is fenced, and the fence is judged before parentage.
A boundary fences causal work rooted at or before its watermark and nothing else: an agent-origin turn opened after it reduces and settles normally.
A cycle a blocking action stopped reports requires_action before anything else; a return to running instead is refused.
A cycle is released when the last action blocking it resolves, not the first; a release with a blocker still pending is refused.
Every blocking action terminalizes before the transition that ends its cycle; a terminal idle with a blocker pending is refused.
An action's first sight carries blocksForeground; absence is refused rather than read as a background action.
A watermark never reaches the sequence of the event carrying it; one at or above it is refused as malformed.
A positive quiescence fact delivered while the foreground is live and an activity is nonterminal is refused; each of its two live conditions is pinned alone by its own vector.
A positive quiescence fact is refused on a live foreground alone, with no activity and no action held.
A positive quiescence fact is refused on one nonterminal activity alone, with the foreground idle and its turn settled.
A positive quiescence fact is refused on one unresolved action alone, with the foreground idle and no activity held.
A positive fact whose watermark leaves a reduced transition uncovered is refused, even with nothing live when it arrives.
A watermark is present exactly when the fact is positive; a negative fact carrying one is refused.
A proof source is present exactly when the fact is positive; a negative fact naming one is refused.
A configuration that proved no quiescence class emits no quiescence_update at all, whichever way the fact points.
A revoked certification is not permanent: a later positive fact covering every reduced event certifies the boundary again.
An idle transition that ends no turn and a suppressed retransmission begin no live work and leave a certification standing.
An activity kind outside the answer's activityKinds is refused.
Where the answer omitted the key, any envelope at all — the opening snapshot included — is refused.
An identifier present carrying the empty string is refused rather than read as an absent member.
A sequence of zero names no event and is refused as malformed rather than as an ordering failure.
A key-reordered retransmission of the snapshot and of a delta are both suppressed: equality is over decoded values, never bytes.
The dedup identity covers the whole notification, so the same envelope beside a member the first delivery did not carry is a conflicting duplicate.
A second snapshot on a live stream is a stream cycle; the same shape on a fenced stream is stale instead.
Close fences the session, so a snapshot announcing a fresh incarnation of a closed session is stale.
A superseded incarnation never resurrects: once a later incarnation's snapshot reduces, a snapshot bearing the prior streamId is stale and the standing projection is untouched.
Carrier legality is structural, so an illegal carrier is reported ahead of the ordering failure the same frame carries.
Ordering identity is validated before the event is reduced, so a snapshot arriving out of contiguity reports the gap.
Structural validity is checked before the discriminant, so a non-integer sequence outranks the unknown event type beside it.
An opaque identifier longer than 4096 bytes fails closed; the bound is checked on the decoded value.
A later action_update restating an immutable member with a different value is refused as an identity change.
A snapshot resuming requires_action with no blocking action in its own action set is refused.
A first-sight activity_update missing an immutable identity field is refused as an identity change, not as an unknown origin.

An update restating a terminal activity with no carried difference is a suppressed no-op: it consumes its sequence, leaves the projection untouched, and does not raise the floor a positive quiescence fact must clear.
A restatement holding the terminal state while carrying a different progress is a carried difference from the reduced terminal record and is refused.
A restatement carrying the terminal state and an identical progress carries no difference and is suppressed.
The terminal comparison basis is the patch, so a minimal terminal patch redelivered at the next sequence is a no-op and the members it omits are not differences.
A delivery that both names a terminal entity and changes an immutable field reports post_terminal_mutation; the terminal token wins.
Numbers compare as exact mathematical values, so a duplicate differing only in writing 1 as 1.0 is an exact retransmission and is suppressed.
A duplicate whose numbers differ only beyond float64 precision is a conflicting duplicate; a certifying consumer compares losslessly.
A huge-exponent literal is decodable and equal to itself: the duplicate is suppressed without the value ever being materialized.
Integer-typed members are lexically integral, so a sequence written 2.0 is malformed however its value reads.
A snapshot listing one activityId twice is malformed, identical entries included; a whole-state set is judged whole rather than deduplicated.
A snapshot listing one actionId twice is malformed; uniqueness binds within each set.
Activities and actions are distinct id spaces, so the same string naming one of each reduces and the two never conflate.
